title: Registered child resolution
description: Resolve candidate child faces to existing global face IDs without creating new faces.
notes: Face identity is node-set based, so candidate node order does not change the global face ID.
Resolution preserves each original candidate index; it must not compact or shift parent-local mappings when an earlier candidate is absent.
Resolution is lookup, not child-face generation. Candidate topology is supplied by the caller and only already-registered faces are returned.

The expected values mirror FaceSearchBasicTest.RegisteredChildResolutionReturnsOnlyKnownChildren. The current geometry workbench stub does not execute the C++ implementation, so native result remains unrecorded.
